title: Kagamine Rin — Adding My Message!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's ready to play whenever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin.
Okay, are we all ready?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ready!
I've been looking forward to seeing your girls' performance at Idol Lovers so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Me too!
I've really been wondering what kind of performance you put on!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Calm down, you two. You'll get to watch in a second.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Airi, are we good to go?!
Can I start playing it?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound just as excited as they are, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, before this anticipation makes all of you explode, let's start watching!
Hit it, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
Play♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<Hello, Idol Lovers!
Are you all having fun?!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I hope the other idols haven't filled you up with too much energy already.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, there they are!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Off to a good start!
The audience looks so excited!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<This is way too much fun!
I don't want this to ever end.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <This is a once-in-a-lifetime moment for ReLight, MORE MORE JUMP! and all of you in the audience!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<We need to savor every second of it.
So, let's use every bit of energy we have left...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And turn this moment where our hearts have become one into a really special memory!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Th-This is awesome...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Airi looks like she's having so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (And she's shining like crazy...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I can't take my eyes off her...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This is uncanny...!
My eyes just keep naturally gravitating towards Airi!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
...!
What an incredible show...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
It's like you were pushing each other higher and higher...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Even though we were just watching a video of it, I got super duper excited.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Imagine how awesome this show was live!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I know...
You all performed so well, it was amazing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Especially the one you did with ReLight.
That was out of this world!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, how do I put it...?
It's like you were all pushing each other to do better to the point where you expended all of your collective energy. You put your feelings on full display.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I felt that as well.
I really wished that performance would never end...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
Performing with ReLight was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I doubt we would've been able to put on that good a performance without ReLight's help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You all became one.
Everyone performing on stage, as well as everyone in the audience. It was such a wonderful moment...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Idols really are the best...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: On the stage were a couple of groups of idols that wanted the audience to smile and have fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They all worked together to shine as brightly as they could and became a united force with everyone watching...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's why I love idols so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's why...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I also wanna be like that!
I wanna become an idol who can spread hope to lots and lots of people!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
So do I!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, now that you've gone over why you love idols so much, let's watch Idol Lovers again from the beginning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I'm sure we're not done talking about the performance, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna keep talking.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, I didn't know such an incredible music festival existed. I could talk about this for weeks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, let's start over from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes!
Let's keep talking about this for as long as we can♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
